categories.definition: Specific prior-dream recollection with temporal context.

inspected_neurological_source.interpretation: Discussion pp9-10 reserves déjà-rêvé for the first two types;dreamy state remains distinct. Déjà vu is not interchangeable.
inspected_neurological_source.limitations: Small selected clinical sample,abbreviated older reports,classification bias and uncertain authenticity of prior-dream recollection. No prospective forecasting endpoint.

evidence_layers.source_report: Published clinical observation and author category;not independently witnessed earlier dream content.
evidence_layers.subjective_memory: Participant recollection/confidence retained without certifying memory authenticity.
evidence_layers.documentary_record: Earlier retained original narrative with hash/version/timestamp provenance;does not prove the dream itself occurred as remembered.
evidence_layers.prospective_timing: Factual earlier/later comparison only;prediction requires a separately preregistered design and is not certified here.
evidence_layers.retrospective_reconstruction: Later descriptions/associations/amendments remain separate from original records.
evidence_layers.unsupported: No diagnosis,neurological localization,memory-authenticity determination or prophecy inference.

proposed_first_profile.name: curot2018-phenomenology-and-dream-record-provenance-v1
proposed_first_profile.status: Proposal only;not an immutable executable profile or supported certification
proposed_first_profile.source_annotation: Human-declared structured attributes and explicit category proposal with reasons. Conservative compatibility checks only;mixed or insufficient declarations return review_required/uncertain. No semantic diagnosis from prose.
proposed_first_profile.source_case_handling: Retain published authors labels as documentary facts with locators. Do not assert a few keywords reproduce their evaluator consensus;table1-5a is a negative control for simplistic text classification.
observation_schema: clinical context declared or ordinary nonclinical context
subjective confidence separate from documentary status
dream_link_schema: retained exact original narrative or restricted local reference
chronology_rules: Compare original lock with experience occurrence and observation first-record separately;strictly earlier,equal,later,unknown andconflicting labels. Preserve timezone-aware strings and interval precision.
Prior dream record means original retained version existed before the experience under declared times;equal time is not strictly earlier. An interval overlapping the boundary remains uncertain.
If an external event is linked,compare original lock and event occurrence separately. Earlier than current recollection does not establish earlier than event.
No earlier original ->subjective_recollection_without_prior_documentary_record;do not call memory false or verified.
A post-event amendment cannot substitute for original content or acquire earlier provenance through a new hash. Preserve original and all alternatives.
Missing original timestamps,wrong parent/hash,backdated declarations andconflicting sequences remain explicit;hash consistency alone is not a trusted timestamp.
A local owner may rewrite an entire chain. Retained independent anchors can improve provenance,but first core must not certify independence or memory authenticity.
proposed_first_profile.candidate_accounting: Freeze the finite user-supplied prior-dream candidate list for each observation before comparisons;record all proposed links,nonmatches,unknowns,excluded candidates and later added searches as new analyses. No best-match-only view or unbounded retrospective retrieval promoted to prospective evidence.
proposed_first_profile.output: Exact source/profile/request/original-version hashes;category declaration and compatibility rationale;all chronology/link statuses,denominators,nonmatches and uncertainty;JSON/Markdown replay. No numeric semantic probability,forecast accuracy or source-derived chance baseline.
proposed_first_profile.reuse44: Reuse only inspected pure timestamp,canonical UTF8 hashing and version/reference integrity helpers if contracts fit. Keep46categories,schemas and timing semantics separate;do not edit44frozen artifacts.
proposed_first_profile.privacy: Voluntary local private records with pseudonyms,explicit consent,rights and bounded attachments. No real clinical interviews or private dream records bundled;reports preserve raw content only in the intended private view.
proposed_first_profile.clinical_boundary: Clinical study observations remain attributed research context. Ordinary self-reports are not classified as epilepsy,localized to brain regions or assigned treatment. No consumer stimulation feature.

independent_fixture_plan.expectation: Documentary table1-4a label retained with relative temporal uncertainty,not an invented exact date or prospectively witnessed dream.
Documentary table1-6a label retained;vague association cannot create a specific earlier record.
Documentary table1-5a label retained independently of words suggesting recent imagery;do not force prior-dream recall.
Conflicting structured subtype declarations return uncertainty/review;all declarations retained.
Manual earlier original-ID/hash lookup succeeds with strict temporal comparison;does not prove subjective authenticity.
Retrospective memory without an original remains subjective and unverified;not labeled false.
Experience before claimed lock,backdated amendment,equal/overlapping/unknown intervals and timezone ordering remain explicit.
Original fixed bytes selected;post-event amendment retained but cannot replace original evidence.
No dream association or episodic content ->outside dream-recollection scope/uncertain;do not silently equate déjà vu.
Declared specificity and temporal evidence independently stored;confidence alone does not create documentation.
Prior dream and event may be documented but manual comparison nonmatch remains in denominator.
All frozen candidate IDs and unsuccessful comparisons retained;later added candidates marked post-hoc.
Valid bytes with missing original timestamp produce unknown chronology,not inferred prospectivity.
No output diagnosis,brain-localization judgment,stimulation recommendation,forecast probability or prophecy certification.
Curot categories versus Dunne recording practices separated;UTF8 whitespace,version hashes,rights/private views and JSON/Markdown replay independently verified.
